summary: Backend-only testing of the 7 new Coaching Headquarters endpoints (PATCH /user/profile, PR CRUD, /achievements, /notes/coach, /notes/ai). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_hq_backend.py with 21 pytest cases covering all spec scenarios plus auth gating. Ran against live http://localhost:8001. Result: 21/21 PASS. Original client name 'Alex Rivera' verified restored after the name-change test. No issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: PATCH /api/personal-records/{pr_id} uses PersonalRecordBody which requires name/value/unit — no true partial patches possible. This matches the request ('Requires all body fields'), but the HTTP verb is misleading (should be PUT semantically). Consider documenting or renaming for consumer clarity.
GET /notes/coach reads db.list_collection_names() on every call — small overhead; consider caching or skipping the check and letting an empty find return [].
seed_data_creation: None. Test creates one Personal Record and deletes it in the same class (test_06_delete). Name change is restored in the auth fixture teardown.
context_for_next_testing_agent: HQ endpoints fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_hq_backend.py (21 cases including auth gating parametrised across all 8 endpoint variants). Reuse the `auth` fixture — it logs in as the seeded client and restores the original name in teardown. PR ID passes across ordered tests via pytest cache (`hq/pr_id`).
